contacts: If ingestion is suspected, call emergency services or go to an emergency department. Do not wait for this app.
National Battery Ingestion Hotline (National Capital Poison Center): 1-800-498-8666
protocol.reese_law_note: Reese's Law (Public Law 117-171, 15 U.S.C. § 2056e, enacted August 16, 2022) directs the Consumer Product Safety Commission to require child-resistant packaging, warning labels, and safer battery compartments. It is a prevention statute. It does not authorize or validate diagnostic software. Source: https://www.congress.gov/bill/117th-congress/house-bill/5313
protocol.safety: Suspected button-battery ingestion requires immediate professional emergency evaluation regardless of this prototype's output. HaloScan does not diagnose, rule out a battery, recommend discharge, or replace emergency care.
